subject: Closure kinetics: coordinated MAP, legal sequencing & order-form timing (SkyRail)
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Park <emily.park@skyrail.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Closure kinetics: MAP draft + immediate sequencing questions

Emily —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Per our conversation, I’ve sketched a first-pass Mutual Action Plan that aligns evaluation milestones with the legal / order-form checkpoints so we can get to signature on a predictable cadence. The attached spreadsheet has the lanes we talked about (technical eval, security evidence, procurement approvals, legal review, and commercial signature).

Key asks for your team:
- Confirm the internal procurement approval window (you mentioned ~2 weeks) — can you confirm exact dates or blackout days?
- Who on your legal team will own the DPA review? If we have a name, we can route early redlines to them.
- Any mandatory procurement forms (vendor questionnaire) we should slot into the MAP?

Proposed timeline (high level):
1) Week 0–2: Evaluation + security questionnaire completion
2) Week 2–4: Legal redline cycle (MSA + DPA)
3) Week 4–5: Order-form and PO submission
4) Week 5: Signature + pilot kickoff

I’d like to lock a target signature week by EOD Friday so our RFQ and resource commitments align. I’ll follow up with an internal note to loop in Legal and PS on sequencing.

Attachment: SkyRail-MAP-v1.xlsx (attachment: spreadsheet)

—Jonas
Jonas Weber
Director, Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

From: Emily Park <emily.park@skyrail.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Sato <tom.sato@skyrail.ai>, Procurement <procurement@skyrail.ai>
Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Closure kinetics: MAP draft + immediate sequencing questions

Jonas —

Appreciate the clear plan. I reviewed the MAP and attached our evaluation matrix and an internal procurement timeline. A few clarifications:
- Procurement window: 2 business-week approval once vendor packet is complete, but we have a finance freeze the week of May 31 — that pushes PO issuance to after June 7 unless we escalate.
- Legal owner: Tom Sato (cc’d) will own the DPA/MSA review. He prefers receiving a single consolidated diff rather than piecemeal redlines.
- Mandatory forms: we require a completed SOC2 evidence checklist and a vendor risk questionnaire. I’ve attached our vendor questionnaire as a tab in the eval matrix.

We can commit to completing the technical eval by June 2 if Redwood provides the same test harness you showed during the demo (containerized inference runner + 3 sample workloads). Can you confirm delivery?

Attachment: SkyRail-Eval-Matrix.pdf (attachment: PDF)

Thanks,
Emily
Emily Park
Head of Product Ops | SkyRail Robotics
emily.park@skyrail.ai | +1 (206) 555-4491

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Park <emily.park@skyrail.ai>, Tom Sato <tom.sato@skyrail.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 13:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Closure kinetics: MAP draft + immediate sequencing questions

Great — thanks for the details and the heads-up on the finance freeze. Two quick items from our side:

1) Delivery: We will provide the containerized test harness and three canonical workloads by Friday (May 21) EOD.
2) Legal sequencing: Laura (cc) will produce a single consolidated MSA+ DPA diff with highlights. To reduce cycle time, our proposal is:
   - Laura sends consolidated diff on Friday May 21
   - Tom reviews and returns comments by Wednesday May 26
   - We triage remaining items via a shared doc and aim to close major open commercial items by May 28

If finance freeze blocks PO issuance until June 8, the practical signature week slips, but we could still agree to commercial terms and provision a pilot (technical onboarding) under a temporary pilot agreement to avoid the gap. That requires legal sign-off on limited-scope pilot terms.

Can Laura confirm she’s able to produce the consolidated diff by Friday? Karthik, can you validate we can support the pilot provisioning in late May if needed?

Attachment: Redwood-MSA-diff-highlights.docx (attachment: Word doc)

—Jonas

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 16:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: SkyRail MAP — next steps & asks (please review)

Team —

Summary of external inputs from SkyRail: finance freeze the week of May 31, legal owner is Tom Sato, they require SOC2 evidence + vendor questionnaire, and technical eval target is June 2.

Immediate internal asks:
- Laura: produce consolidated MSA+DPA diff by EOD Friday May 21. Flag any non-starter terms (data residency, subprocurement, indemnity caps) in the doc.
- Karthik: confirm PS capacity for a limited-scope pilot starting May 29 (2 engineers x 3 weeks). If not possible, propose earliest alternative window.
- Vanessa: prep a short commercial fallback note that outlines: (A) temporary pilot agreement terms we can accept without full PO; (B) maximum discount band if we need to accommodate expedited signature.

I’ll keep Emily/Tom in the loop and ask them to confirm procurement blackout days and whether they can escalate finance to enable PO issuance. We should aim for the MAP to reflect both the ideal/contingent signature weeks so stakeholders have visibility.

Thanks — plan to sync 10am Thursday if you want a quick alignment call.

—Jonas
Director, Enterprise Sales
